answer: Cross-Epoch Conduct Ledger. Each identity's actions must fall within a bounded band of its own prior-epoch behavior; deviations beyond a threshold flag it. An attacker must run every clone through genuine varied history across epochs, never letting any sit at a nadir of activity, or risk detection. Over a river of successive epochs, maintaining divergent believable trajectories for many sockpuppets costs sustained compute and coordination. Honest agents in a meadow of normal use drift little, so clones stand out.
